cues: Agreement is not only subject and verb.
A pronoun matches its antecedent: every student must bring his or her admit card; the committee announced its decision.
This kind of book is useful; these kinds of books are useful, never these kind of.
Number compounds used as adjectives stay singular: a five year old boy, a ten rupee note, but the boy is five years old.
And a past main verb pulls the next clause into the past, except a universal truth: the teacher told us that the earth moves round the sun.
